title: ci.yml's operating-block digest job claims this repo is private; it is public
summary: opum-agent flagged during the OMARK-29-33 migration: ci.yml's operating-block digest job comment says the pinned-digest approach (rather than a live cross-repo fetch of opum-doc's canonical document) is used because 'Both repos are private, so a cross-repo fetch in CI would need more than the default GITHUB_TOKEN'. Checked directly, not assumed: gh api repos/opum-ai/opum-marketplace --jq '{default_branch, private}' returns private: false. This repo is public. Whether opum-doc is also public, and whether that changes anything about the digest-vs-fetch design rationale, is unverified and out of scope for this task -- filed to record the finding, not to fix the design. Orthogonal to the main-branch migration (OMARK-29 through OMARK-33); noted during it, not caused by it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Check opum-doc's own private/public status via gh api, the same way this repo's was checked, rather than assuming it matches or differs.

Decide explicitly whether the stale 'both repos are private' claim changes anything about the pinned-digest-vs-live-fetch design rationale for the operating-block check -- a public repo CAN be fetched cross-repo with just the default GITHUB_TOKEN, which the comment's own reasoning says was the blocker. The acceptable outcome includes 'no, the pinned digest is still better/simpler regardless of visibility, leave it and just fix the comment' -- the point is a deliberate decision recorded either way, not a design change guaranteed by filing this.
If the comment's factual claim is corrected, correct it precisely (which repos, checked when) rather than just deleting the specific-but-wrong detail.

implementationNotes: Verified the job this task is about no longer exists: 'grep -n "digest\|private" .github/workflows/*.yml' finds nothing. Traced why: OMARK-39 (commit f75924f, 2026-09-09, the same day this task was filed) retired the pinned-digest CI check entirely and replaced the inline operating-block copy with the @~/.claude/opum-fleet-operating.md import that CLAUDE.md still uses today -- 'one copy cannot drift from itself'. This task's premise (a stale comment in a job that claims both repos are private) is moot because the job itself, comment included, was deleted, not because the comment was corrected in place.
finalSummary: Closed as moot, per PR #132. Verified the digest job this task is about no longer exists in .github/workflows/*.yml -- OMARK-39 (commit f75924f, same day this task was filed) retired the pinned-digest CI check entirely and replaced it with the @~/.claude/opum-fleet-operating.md import CLAUDE.md still uses. The stale 'both repos are private' comment was deleted along with the job, not corrected in place, so this task's three acceptance criteria (check opum-doc's visibility, decide on the design rationale, correct the comment) no longer apply to any code that exists. Left unchecked rather than falsely marked delivered.
